about: Representative BSEP (ABCB11) efflux-inhibition IC50 anchors (SHH assay, micromolar) used by the R-7 cholestasis validation case (validation/cases/case_liver_cholestasis_pbk.py) and the organ cholestasis lane (src/drugos/organ/liver.py). Transcribed from the open-access publication of de Bruijn & Rietjens, Arch. Toxicol. 98:3077-3095 (2024), doi:10.1007/s00204-024-03775-6 (CC BY 4.0), which validated the GCDCA bile-acid PBK against the clinical cholestasis signal of ~18 marketed drugs; underlying IC50 measurements originate in the primary BSEP inhibition literature (Morgan 2010; Marchant 2019).
classification: compounds with SHH IC50 below ~5 uM are classified as BSEP inhibitors (cholestasis-sensitive) in the validated ranking
